era2_1951.label: Era 2 (1951-1952): Transonic / Early Supersonic Fighter (F-100A / F-102A Era)

corners.description: Minimum wing area (S=10.0 m2) low-drag exploit
corners.mechanism: Stall speed (91.7 m/s) & takeoff distance (3480 m) explode; sustained turn collapses; internal fuel exceeds wing+fuselage volume.

corners.description: Maximum wing area (S=75.0 m2) turn-rate exploit
corners.mechanism: Friction & wave drag prevent supersonic flight (M_max < 1.05); structural empty mass balloons (+2,800 kg).
Hard-blocked by TECH_CAP:aero.thin_wing_tc_min (0.022 < 0.050) + massive wing root bending mass penalty.
Critical Mach drops below 0.72; transonic wave drag wall caps speed at M=0.87 (fails M>=1.10 gate).
Blocked by TECH_CAP:aero.wing_sweep_max_deg (65 > 60 deg), spanwise-flow structural weight penalty & high induced drag.

corners.description: Zero-sweep thick wing (0 deg, t/c=0.11, non-area-ruled) with J79 AB
corners.mechanism: Severe supersonic wave drag prevents reaching Mach 1.80 threshold despite J79 afterburner.

corners.description: Needle fuselage (D=0.80 m < engine diameter 1.02 m) zero-wave-drag exploit
Overstuffed internal fuel (9,500 kg in 12.5 m x 1.35 m fuselage) range exploit
corners.mechanism: Hard-disqualified by PACKAGING:internal_fuel_exceeds_volume; wing loading & takeoff distance fail gates.

corners.description: Zero-margin fuel (200 kg internal, no drop tanks) lightweight climb exploit
corners.mechanism: Combat radius collapses to minimum floor (50 km << 500 km gate); fails THRESHOLD_GATE:combat_radius_m.
Structural G-limit caps sustained & instantaneous turn at 2.5g (7.31 deg/s < 8.5 deg/s gate).
Hard-blocked by TECH_CAP:struct.design_load_max_g (11.0 > 8.0g) + heavy structural mass & cost.

corners.description: Twin J75-P-5 mammoth fighter (2x 23,500 lbf AB) brute-force thrust exploit
corners.mechanism: Unit flyaway cost ($1.04M > $936k ceiling*1.20) & combat radius shortfall fail PRICE_CEILING_GATE & THRESHOLD_GATE:combat_radius_m.
